observed_evidence: China kept the one-year Loan Prime Rate at 3.00% and the five-year LPR at 3.50% for September, the 16th consecutive month without a change. Reuters reported the outcome matched the unanimous forecast of 21 surveyed market participants.
semantic_interpretation: The hold preserves a relatively restrained broad-easing stance despite weak domestic demand. For Taiwan equities this is primarily a China-demand and regional-rate backdrop rather than a new shock. No inference is made that the unchanged LPR directly changes Taiwan company fundamentals or Fair Value.
